t: Nobody in the list is exempt
a: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ، فَالإِمَامُ رَاعٍ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ وَالرَّجُلُ رَاعٍ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ وَالْمَرْأَةُ رَاعِيَةٌ عَلَى بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا وَهْىَ مَسْئُولَةٌ
p: Kullukum rāʿin wa kullukum masʾūl. Fa-l-imāmu rāʿin wa huwa masʾūl, wa-r-rajulu rāʿin ʿalā ahlihi wa huwa masʾūl, wa-l-marʾatu rāʿiyatun ʿalā bayti zawjihā wa hiya masʾūlah
m: Every one of you is a shepherd and every one of you is responsible. The leader is a shepherd and is responsible. A man is a shepherd over his household and is responsible. A woman is a shepherd over her husband's house and is responsible.
